utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Niamh Quigley. I’ve been charged unarranged overdraft fees and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that, Niamh. Before I look at anything on the account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Niamh Quigley, 14th of March 1982.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Flat 3, 18 Larkfield Road.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s verified. I can see why those charges would be frustrating. Can you tell me a little more about what’s happened?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I went over my limit last month and there are fees on there now. I don’t think they’re fair, especially with everything I’ve got going on.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry. What else is going on, if you’re comfortable telling me?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’m having chemotherapy at the moment, so it’s been hard to keep on top of things.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m really sorry you’re going through that, Niamh. We can put you in touch with our Financial Support team, and they may be able to discuss extra time or other support with you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Can you get these fees refunded?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t promise any outcome. Our unarranged overdraft fees can never be refunded, though I can log your complaint about them.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Please do. I want the bank to look at how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’m logging this as a complaint about the unarranged overdraft fees and your concerns about how they were handled.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: What happens now?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Someone will be in touch about the complaint, and you’ll be told about the next steps. I can’t give you a timescale for that.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, I’ve logged the complaint, and someone will be in touch about what happens next. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Niamh. I’m sorry this has been stressful, and thank you for speaking with me today.
